desc:
Hyper realistic ragdoll physics sandbox: every punch, shot and blast changes how dummies move.

Each body part reacts on its own. Shoot a leg and they limp, break it and they crawl. Break an arm and it goes limp. Hit the head and they faint.

💥 REAL RAGDOLL PHYSICS
• Dummies stumble, fight back and get up
• Grab dummies, swing them and throw them
• X-ray broken bones in the Body Scan

🔫 WEAPONS AND TOOLS
• Katana, Sniper, Minigun, Rocket Launcher, Flamethrower, Void Gun and more
• Unlock new weapons as you play

🧱 DESTROY EVERYTHING
• Walls, towers and trees break apart
• Tornado, Tsunami, Meteor Rain and more

🧠 LIVING DUMMIES
• They talk, panic and help each other
• A Medkit or Defibrillator brings them back
• Zombies rise from the graveyard

🐊 WILD WORLD
• Shark, crocodile, giant spider, T-Rex and more
• Giant fan, rocket, cannon, crusher, Fight Ring
• Drive a car, Monster Truck or Battle Tank
